summary: Create your own Toons, recreate iconic Toons like Astro and Vee, and watch them come alive in a pixel town you build with Redbean - a free Dandy's World OC maker
body_markdown:
[Dandy’s World](https://www.roblox.com/games/16116270224/Dandys-World) is BlushCrunch Studio’s multiplayer horror game on Roblox, where players control cheerful Toons trying to survive a candy factory while dodging their monstrous Twisted counterparts. The game has built one of Roblox’s most active communities, with fans constantly redesigning, shipping, and creating OCs inspired by its charming characters.


If you’re searching for a **Dandy’s World OC maker** tool with a base or template, ***Redbean*** might not be the best one out there, but it can turn your Toon OC into something more: **a pixel, playable character that comes to life** through conversations and stories, living in a world you build yourself!

##


**Things You Need To Know About Dandy’s World Characters**


#


Dandy’s World characters list includes around 40[playable Toons](https://dandys-world-robloxhorror.fandom.com/wiki/Toons) , split into distinct roles based on their rarity, costs, and stats. New players start by picking one of two free Toons, Boxten or Poppy. Main Characters like Astro, Pebble or Vee can be unlocked earlier in the game, each with a signature ability and their own web of dialogue with the rest of the cast. Dandy himself, the host of the factory, and Dyle are playable only under specific conditions.


**Toon** **Category** **Image** **What they’re known for**


[Astro](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/astro-3udnu4bn5ft4) Main Character \[render\] A quiet, dream-themed Toon who restores teammates’ stamina; introverted, but has a dry sense of humor around Toons he trusts, like Vee.


[Vee](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/vee-kob5gniq36kd) Main Character \[render\] A sharp TV/game-show-host Toon who reveals every Twisted and machine on the floor; blunt on the surface, secretly insecure underneath.


Pebble Main Character \[render\] Dandy’s dog-coded pet rock; can’t speak beyond barks, but sniffs out hidden items and stays fiercely loyal to his owner.


Shelly Main Character \[render\] An extroverted, dinosaur-obsessed ammonite who boosts a teammate’s extraction speed, staying upbeat even though most of the cast overlooks her.


Sprout Main Character \[render\] A caretaking strawberry Toon who heals injured teammates and tracks everyone’s health, fiercely protective of his best friend Cosmo.


Bassie Main Character \[render\] A shy Easter-basket Toon who shares items from her inventory; quietly anxious about being replaced by the more popular Cocoa.


Bobette Main Character \[render\] A cheerful Christmas ornament who hands out speed and stamina to nearby teammates, hiding how overwhelmed the holiday duties actually make her.


Gourdy Main Character \[render\] An excitable young pumpkin who hands teammates random buffs, openly idolizing the other Main Characters while missing his own parents.


Dandy Lethal \[render\] The flower-shaped mascot who runs the whole factory and its shop; cheerful on the surface, hiding what really happened during the Ichor Operation.


Dyle Lethal \[render\] A pocket-watch Toon who runs the trains and sells cosmetics; all-business and lonely, since he was left out of the original show.


Regular Toons Regular — The other 23 Toons bought in Dandy’s Store, including Blot, Brightney, Cosmo, Flutter, Gigi, Rodger, and Tisha.


Event Toons Event — The rest of the seasonal cast beyond Bassie, Bobette, and Gourdy: Cocoa, Eggson, Flyte, Eclipse, Ribecca, Soulvester, Coal, Ginger, and Rudie.


Every Toon has a matching Twisted form, the monstrous version that hunts players on the floors below the factory, with a different one rotated onto the game’s Twisted Board each day. The list of Dandy’s World characters is still growing through regular updates and 2026 merchandise drops, as an abundant source of inspiration for fans to create their own characters.


##


**Dandy’s World OC Maker: Create & Play with Your OC in Redbean**


#


Most Dandy’s World character maker tools stop at picking a premade base, template and customizing colors or accessories: an OC/character with a name and a personality its creator decides. Even with cool design, it remains static and lives in the creator’s imagination, never actually becoming a playable character as an original Toon in Dandy’s World.


**Redbean** is a mobile sandbox (free-to-play on iOS and Android), built around exactly that gap: Make your OC or favorite characters come alive as a playable pixel character, drop it into a town you build, and actually interact with it. It works as a Dandy’s World OC maker for drawing your own character, recreating your favorite Toons, exploring new Dandy’s World OC ideas, or building a world entirely your own.


✨ **Create your Dandy’s World OC from a photo or by drawing from scratch.** Upload a reference image or sketch a few strokes, and Redbean turns it into a pixel Toon that can move, talk, and hold a place in your town, not just a static design.


📝 **Give it a name, persona, and lore.** For Dandy’s World OC ideas, try basing a new Toon on an existing one’s theme (a Dandy’s World Astro OC built around dreams and quiet company, for instance), or reimagine one with a Dandy’s World AU twist inspired by its Twisted counterpart, the kind of redesign the fandom already does constantly. Once it has a name and backstory, Redbean turns it into a pixel Toon that remembers what you tell it and builds relationships with the rest of your cast.


🏡 **Drop it into a living pixel town.** Your Toon can walk around, talk to the other characters and OCs you’ve made, and those conversations are remembered and shape how relationships change over time.


🪄 **Shape the town yourself.** Restyle the whole town around any theme in a few words, and build your own furniture and decorations by sketch, description, or photo.


🌃 **Explore other towns, or build your own multiverse.** Redbean’s Explore tab lets you visit pixel towns other players built and meet the Toons and OCs they made, watching them interact with each other. You can also bring in a cast from any other universe like[Animal Hospital](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-oc-maker) or[The Amazing Digital Circus](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/the-amazing-digital-circus-games-2026) , mix them with your Dandy’s World OCs, and build the fandom AU you’ve been imagining.


*Redbean isn’t affiliated with BlushCrunch Studio. It’s a playground for fans to build their own version of the Toons they already love.*


##


**FAQ**


#


###


**Who is Dandy in Dandy’s World?**


#


Dandy is the mascot who runs the candy factory where the whole game takes place, and the character the Lethal-tier Dandy Toon is themed around. Long-time lore ties him to Astro through a shared history at the factory before it turned dangerous, part of why the two share one of the more detailed dialogue threads in the game.


###


**How do you create your own Dandy’s World OC?**


#


Start with a base, a photo or a quick sketch, then decide its theme the way the official cast does: one clear trait or motif (Astro’s dreams, Vee’s tech, Sprout’s care for others) built out into a personality. A Dandy’s World OC maker like Redbean turns that sketch and backstory into a pixel Toon you can actually place in a town and talk to.


###


**What is Astro’s personality like in Dandy’s World?**


#


Astro is the quiet, dream-themed Main Character: introverted and calm on the surface, with a dry, playful side that only shows around Toons he’s close with, like Vee and Razzle & Dazzle. He’s shy about being the center of attention but genuinely looks out for the rest of the cast, which makes him a popular pick to base a Dandy’s World Astro OC on.


###


**What’s the difference between a Toon and its Twisted form?**


#


A Toon is the friendly, playable version of a character; its Twisted is the monstrous form that hunts Toons through the factory floors. Every character has both, and the game rotates a different one onto the Twisted Board each day. Some fans use Twisted forms as inspiration for a darker Dandy’s World AU redesign of their own OCs.


###


**Can I use Redbean for OCs from other fandoms too?**


#


Yes. Dandy’s World is one of many fandoms people recreate in Redbean, and the same in-game OC maker tool works for any character, canon or original, from any series. You can build a single-fandom town, or mix Dandy’s World Toons with OCs and characters from completely different fandoms into one multiverse.


Whichever Toon you start with, an existing favorite or something built from scratch, Redbean is where a Dandy’s World OC stops being just a drawing and gets a name, a persona, a town, and a world that actually plays out its story.
